how: uv run python tools/mutants.py docs/quantities/qt-a1c/mutants.json --no-baseline --evidence docs/quantities/qt-a1c/evidence/mutants-run.json, after a passing `lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples`; each mutant is applied alone, the module and its dependents are built, the file is restored. A mutant in a definition fails at the theorem it breaks; evidence/guards-under-mutants.txt shows the FA1b and FA2 #guards failing too when that proof is stubbed.

mutants.claim: count_atLeast_agree: "at least n" is -#b <= -n, as W6a's atLeast
mutants.find: def atLeastAtom (s : String) (b : Body) (n : Nat) : CountAtom := ⟨s, [(-1, b)], .le, -(n : Int)⟩
mutants.replace: def atLeastAtom (s : String) (b : Body) (n : Nat) : CountAtom := ⟨s, [(-1, b)], .lt, -(n : Int)⟩
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: count_atMost_agree: "at most n" is #b <= n, as W6a's atMost
mutants.find: def atMostAtom (s : String) (b : Body) (n : Nat) : CountAtom := ⟨s, [(1, b)], .le, n⟩
mutants.replace: def atMostAtom (s : String) (b : Body) (n : Nat) : CountAtom := ⟨s, [(1, b)], .lt, n⟩
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: count_exactly_agree: "exactly n" is #b = n, as W6a's exactly
mutants.find: def exactlyAtom (s : String) (b : Body) (n : Nat) : CountAtom := ⟨s, [(1, b)], .eq, n⟩
mutants.replace: def exactlyAtom (s : String) (b : Body) (n : Nat) : CountAtom := ⟨s, [(1, b)], .le, n⟩
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: count_nOfM_agree: "exactly n of the m" counts the selected objects with the property, as W6a's nOfM
mutants.find: .and (.count (exactlyAtom s sel m)) (.count (exactlyAtom s (.and sel prop) n))
mutants.replace: .and (.count (exactlyAtom s sel m)) (.count (exactlyAtom s prop n))
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples
cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: refutesC_sound: countFin counts each listed object once
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: refutesC_sound: on the finite model each region constant is its own region's size
mutants.find: | some (_, s, r) => some (.inr (countFin M s (regionBody (predsOn E fs s) r)))
mutants.replace: | some (_, s, r) => some (.inr (countFin M s .any))
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: refutesC_sound: the finite model's regions are the erased problem's (conclusion included)
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: refutesC_sound: the check refutes the erased conclusion itself
mutants.find: ((erasedProblem E ps c).1.map QFormula.erase) (erasedProblem E ps c).2.erase
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: fixture fa1b_not_entails: the countermodel refutes FA1 only without the exclusion premise
mutants.find: theorem fa1b_not_entails : ¬ CEntails.{0} fomc fa1.dropLast fa1Conclusion :=
mutants.replace: theorem fa1b_not_entails : ¬ CEntails.{0} fomc fa1 fa1Conclusion :=
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples

mutants.claim: fixture fa2_agree: W6a's "at least 4" fails on a model with 3, through count_atLeast_agree
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.Examples
